title: Graph Definition and Execution
summary: This module defines the core components for building, executing, and managing directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or state machines, including nodes, steps, joins, and the graph execution engine.

nodes.label: Define Graph Structure (Beta)
nodes.title: Beta Graph Definition
nodes.description: Defines the complete structure of a graph, including nodes, edges, state, and dependencies. Provides methods for running and iterating through execution.

nodes.label: Manage Graph Execution (Beta)
nodes.title: Beta Graph Run Instance
nodes.description: Manages a single execution instance of a beta graph, orchestrating state, dependencies, and inputs. Provides an async iterator for step-by-step execution.

nodes.label: Execute Graph Tasks
nodes.title: Graph Task Iterator
nodes.description: Internal engine for asynchronous iteration and execution of graph tasks. Handles scheduling, result processing, and managing active tasks and join reducers.

nodes.label: Define Atomic Step
nodes.title: Graph Step
nodes.description: Represents a single, atomic unit of work or computation within the graph, encapsulating a step function and metadata.

nodes.label: Aggregate Parallel Results
nodes.title: Graph Join Operation
nodes.description: Synchronizes and aggregates results from multiple parallel execution paths using a reducer function.

nodes.label: Analyze Fork-Join Patterns
nodes.title: Parent Fork Finder
nodes.description: Analyzes graph structure to identify dominating parent forks for join nodes, crucial for coordinating parallel execution and preventing deadlocks.

nodes.label: Construct Execution Paths
nodes.title: Path Builder
nodes.description: Provides a fluent API for constructing execution paths within the graph, allowing chaining of transformations, mapping, and broadcasting.

nodes.label: Define Graph Structure (Legacy)
nodes.title: Legacy Graph Definition
nodes.description: The older graph definition, where nodes explicitly define their next possible steps. Provides methods for running, iterating, and visualizing the graph.

nodes.label: Manage Graph Execution (Legacy)
nodes.title: Legacy Graph Run Instance
nodes.description: Manages a single execution instance of a legacy graph, handling execution flow, persistence, and state.

nodes.label: Store Execution Outcome
nodes.title: Graph Run Result
nodes.description: Encapsulates the final outcome of a graph execution, including the output, the final state, and the persistence object.

nodes.label: Define Graph Node
nodes.title: Base Graph Node
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all nodes in the graph, defining the 'run' method and providing utilities for node identification and documentation.

nodes.label: Persist Graph State
nodes.title: State Persistence
nodes.description: External component responsible for saving and loading the graph's state and execution history.

nodes.label: Visualize Graph
nodes.title: Mermaid Renderer
nodes.description: External utility for generating Mermaid diagram code and images from graph definitions.

groups.label: Beta Graph Definition
groups.title: Beta Graph Definition
groups.description: Defines graph structure using explicit steps, joins, and path builders for advanced workflows.

groups.label: Beta Graph Execution Engine
groups.title: Beta Graph Execution Engine
groups.description: Manages the asynchronous, step-by-step execution of beta graphs, handling task scheduling, fork-join logic, and state management.

groups.label: Legacy Graph Definition
groups.title: Legacy Graph Definition
groups.description: Provides a simpler graph definition where nodes directly specify their next possible steps.

groups.label: Legacy Graph Execution Flow
groups.title: Legacy Graph Execution Flow
groups.description: Manages the execution and results of legacy graph runs, including state persistence.

groups.label: Graph State Persistence
groups.title: Graph State Persistence
groups.description: Handles the saving and loading of graph state and execution snapshots.

groups.label: Graph Visualization
groups.title: Graph Visualization
groups.description: Tools for rendering graph structures into visual diagrams.
